rules.title: Boston fair housing protection for rental assistance (source of income)
rules.requirement: In Boston it is illegal to discriminate in renting housing based on rental assistance, such as Section 8 vouchers. A landlord telling you they don't accept rental assistance is an example of housing discrimination.
rules.coverage_text: Renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston; protects renters using rental assistance such as Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance.
